snippet.title: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4968700/Hoop_Dynasty_Rise_of_a_Legend/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic_video&utm_campaign=us_coming_soon_launch&utm_content=official_gameplay_trailer_en

Build a basketball career the world will remember. Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend is a single-player basketball career manager set in a living, original basketball world.

Create your prospect, define your role, traits and mentality, then choose where your story begins: College, International or Pro. Earn your role. Develop your game. Navigate coaches, agents, contracts, pressure and career-defining decisions while the world around you keeps moving through new seasons, rivalries, champions and dynasties.

Your performances shape more than a stat line. Championships, awards, national team selections, records and decisive moments determine whether your name reaches the Pantheon.

KEY FEATURES
• Single-player basketball career manager
• College, International and Pro career paths
• Complete player creation, development and progression
• Match Center, calendars, standings, playoffs and season history
• Global market, contracts, agents, sponsors and career decisions
• National teams, global competitions, awards and records
• Pantheon, historical archives, dynasties and long-term memory
• A completely original universe with no real teams or players
• Local save files with no mandatory internet connection

EXPLORE THE BASKETBALL CAREER GAME:
https://hoopdynasty.info/game.html

HOW THE CAREER SIMULATION WORKS:
https://hoopdynasty.info/stories/basketball-career-simulation.html

Discord:
https://discord.com/invite/sEmzpd8X3J

Instagram:
https://www.instagram.com/hoop_dynasty_official/

TikTok:
https://www.tiktok.com/@hoopdynasty_official

Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend is an original fictional basketball career manager. Teams, players, leagues, awards, logos, names, histories and statistics depicted in the game are fictional and are not affiliated with or endorsed by any real-world organization.
